title: Inference-Time-Compute-Scaling
summary: It is cited as an enabler for Beyond-Parameter-Scaling; Proof of concept record tracked across 124 sources.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Inference-Time-Compute-Scaling.

Laboratory or proof-of-concept demonstrations successful. Commercial path is not yet clear. Our research database tracks 124 independent sources on this technology.

First open-source model matching OpenAI o1 on reasoning benchmarks. Pure RL (GRPO) without supervised fine-tuning for cold-start. Chain-of-thought reasoning emerges from RL. Demonstrates reasoning capability can be incentivized purely through RL. Major milestone for open-source AI.
